name: @parcha/tether
description: Slack threads that stay attached to Codex, Claude Code, Zellij, and headless agents through Hermes

scripts.test: (command -v bandit >/dev/null && bandit -q -r runtime skills/tether/scripts || echo 'bandit not installed; CI enforces it') && (command -v ruff >/dev/null && ruff check runtime skills/tether/scripts herdr-plugin tests || echo 'ruff not installed; CI enforces it') && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v && python3 -m py_compile runtime/bridge_runtime.py runtime/domain_control.py runtime/domain_schema.py runtime/schema_orchestrator.py runtime/schema_receipt.py runtime/schema_rehearsal.py runtime/domain_runtime.py runtime/native_driver.py runtime/hermes_compat.py runtime/routing.py runtime/security.py runtime/slack_protocol.py runtime/plugin/__init__.py runtime/plugin_next/__init__.py runtime/plugin_next/admission.py runtime/plugin_next/journal.py skills/tether/scripts/tether_notify.py herdr-plugin/tether_plugin.py && python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; assert "name: tether" in Path("runtime/plugin/plugin.yaml").read_text()' && python3 -c 'import tomllib; from pathlib import Path; p=tomllib.loads(Path("herdr-plugin/herdr-plugin.toml").read_text()); assert p["id"] == "parcha.tether" and p["version"] == "0.3.0-beta.1"' && python3 -m json.tool .claude-plugin/plugin.json >/dev/null && python3 -m json.tool .codex-plugin/plugin.json >/dev/null && python3 -m json.tool .agents/plugins/marketplace.json >/dev/null && node --check bin/tether.js && bash -n install.sh && bash tests/test_release_install.sh && bash tests/test_release_tarball.sh
scripts.test:release: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_release_*.py' -v && node --check bin/tether.js && bash -n install.sh && bash tests/test_release_install.sh && bash tests/test_release_tarball.sh
scripts.lint: ruff check runtime skills/tether/scripts herdr-plugin tests && bandit -q -r runtime skills/tether/scripts

author: Parcha Labs (https://parcha.com)
